title.en: Inbound Ad-Lead Qualification & Sub-10s CRM Router
title.bm: Sistem Kelayakan Prospek Iklan & Penghala CRM Bawah-10 Saat

businessObjective.en: Automatically qualifies new B2B ad enquiries, syncs verified leads to HubSpot CRM, and equips sales reps with an instant email alert, Gmail draft, and 1-click WhatsApp opener in under 10 seconds.
businessObjective.bm: Menilai pertanyaan iklan B2B baharu secara automatik, menyegerakkan prospek sah ke HubSpot CRM, serta membekalkan pasukan jualan dengan makluman e-mel segera, draf Gmail dan pembuka WhatsApp 1-klik dalam tempoh bawah 10 saat.

martechInsight.en: B2B speed-to-lead decay is steep: qualification odds drop sharply after 5 minutes, while unverified free-email or dead-domain submissions waste rep hours. Deterministic HTTP domain reachability checks + spend-tier rules filter out spam (Tier 3) before AI drafts tailored openers — replacing expensive Zapier/Make task tiers at RM 0/mo.
martechInsight.bm: Kelewatan respons prospek B2B menjejaskan kadar penukaran secara drastik selepas 5 minit, manakala borang daripada domain mati atau e-mel peribadi membazirkan masa wakil jualan. Semakan kebolehcapaian HTTP domain dan peraturan aras bajet menapis spam (Tier 3) secara deterministik sebelum AI merangka skrip pembuka khusus — menggantikan caj bulanan Zapier/Make pada kos RM 0/bln.

commercialLeak.en: High-intent B2B inbound leads going cold due to manual spreadsheet triage and expensive recurring Zapier/Make task limits.
commercialLeak.bm: Prospek masuk B2B berniat tinggi menjadi sejuk dan terlepas akibat saringan manual serta kos langganan tugasan bulanan Zapier/Make yang mahal.

title.en: Paid Ads POAS & Broken-URL Sentinel Guardrail
title.bm: Sistem Kawalan Paid Ads POAS & Pemantau Pautan Rosak

businessObjective.en: Checks live ad landing pages hourly for 404/500 errors and audits true profit-after-product-cost (Net POAS) daily so broken links or inflated Meta ROAS never drain ad spend.
businessObjective.bm: Menyemak halaman pendaratan iklan setiap jam untuk mengesan ralat 404/500 serta mengaudit keuntungan sebenar selepas kos produk (Net POAS) setiap hari supaya pautan rosak atau ROAS Meta yang mengelirukan tidak membazirkan bajet.

martechInsight.en: Platform-reported Meta ROAS ignores COGS, fees, and landing-page failures ('Ghost ROAS'): in sandbox tests, Ad 120210004 showed 3.51x Meta ROAS while verified Net POAS was 0.55x (-RM 247 net loss), and HTTP 404 Ad 120210001 dropped Connect Rate to 8.04% vs 83–88% on healthy ads. Combining sample-size floors with Hook/Hold Rate diagnostics prevents both false alarms and silent budget bleed.
martechInsight.bm: ROAS yang dilaporkan oleh platform Meta mengabaikan COGS, caj platform dan kegagalan halaman pendaratan ('Ghost ROAS'): dalam ujian sandbox, iklan 120210004 memaparkan 3.51x Meta ROAS sedangkan Net POAS sebenar hanyalah 0.55x (rugi -RM 247), manakala iklan HTTP 404 (120210001) menjatuhkan Connect Rate kepada 8.04% berbanding 83–88%. Gabungan lantai sampel minimum dengan diagnostik Hook/Hold Rate mengelakkan penggera palsu serta kebocoran bajet senyap.

commercialLeak.en: Silent ad spend bleed on broken destination URLs (HTTP 404/500), creative fatigue, and sub-floor gross ROAS campaigns that lose money after COGS.
commercialLeak.bm: Pembaziran belanja iklan secara senyap pada pautan halaman rosak (404/500), kelesuan kreatif, dan kempen ROAS kasar yang rugi selepas ditolak COGS.

deterministicGate.en: Deterministic HTTP status check, minimum spend/impression sample-size gates, and post-COGS Net POAS calculation.
deterministicGate.bm: Semakan status HTTP deterministik, syarat sampel minimum belanja/impresi, dan kiraan Net POAS selepas tolak kos produk (COGS).

boundedAiRole.en: Generates root-cause creative fatigue diagnostics and structured ad iteration briefs only after deterministic flags trigger.
boundedAiRole.bm: Menjana diagnosis punca kelesuan kreatif dan ringkasan iterasi iklan berstruktur hanya selepas syarat deterministik dicetuskan.

validatedOutcome.en: Automated sub-floor POAS & dead-link detection gated against small-sample false alarms, flagging RM 692.34 in at-risk 7-day spend out of RM 2,691.
validatedOutcome.bm: Pengesanan automatik pautan mati & kempen bawah had POAS tanpa penggera palsu sampel kecil, menyelamatkan RM 692.34 bajet berisiko daripada RM 2,691 belanja 7 hari.

summary.bm: Pencetus masa Apps Script menarik metrik 7-hari Meta Ads (belanja, Hook/Hold rate, CTR 3H vs 7H, Connect Rate) serta URL destinasi ke dalam Raw_Meta_Ingest.

summary.bm: Menjalankan pengesahan status HTTP langsung (menghentikan 404), menyemak lantai sampel Config_Thresholds serta baki stok SKU, dan mengira Net POAS selepas COGS.

summary.bm: Apabila status ITERATE_HOOK atau ROTATE_CREATIVE_FATIGUE dicetuskan, Gemini menjana ringkasan Google Docs bersama 3 skrip tajuk iklan BM sedia rakam.

title.en: DTC Retention, RFM Churn Z-Score & VIP CAPI Signal Engine
title.bm: Enjin Pengekalan DTC, Z-Score Risiko Pelanggan & Isyarat VIP CAPI

businessObjective.en: Spots when profitable repeat buyers are overdue to reorder based on their product usage cycle, sends margin-safe WhatsApp win-backs, and feeds only high-profit VIP buyers back to Meta Ads.
businessObjective.bm: Mengesan apabila pelanggan ulangan berkeuntungan tinggi lewat membuat belian semula mengikut kitaran guna produk, menghantar mesej WhatsApp bermargin selamat, dan menyalurkan hanya pembeli VIP bernilai tinggi kembali ke Meta Ads.

martechInsight.en: Rising CAC cannot be solved with blanket discounts: margin-gated coupons (approving KEMBALI10 10% for MARGIN_WINBACK while blocking promos on VIP_FULL_PRICE) protect net profit, COD_BLACKLIST flags repeat COD-returners (-RM 15 courier penalty), and SKU replenishment cycles (30d/60d) + Z-Score flag overdue buyers early while SHA-256 VIP CAPI v21.0 trains Meta toward repeat LTV.
martechInsight.bm: Kenaikan CAC tidak boleh diselesaikan dengan diskaun pukal: kupon berpagar margin (meluluskan KEMBALI10 10% bagi MARGIN_WINBACK tetapi menyekat promo pada VIP_FULL_PRICE) melindungi untung bersih, COD_BLACKLIST menandakan pemulang COD berulang (-RM 15 penalti kurier), manakala kitaran produk (30h/60h) + Z-Score mengesan kelewatan awal dan CAPI VIP SHA-256 melatih Meta mencari pembeli berulang bernilai tinggi.

businessObjective.bm: Menyelaraskan tuntutan hasil bertindih merentas Meta, TikTok dan Google Ads berbanding tunai sebenar masuk bank, mengasingkan pembaziran kanibalisasi Branded serta PMax, dan memandu pengagihan bajet selamat Learning Phase ke arah pemerolehan pelanggan baharu yang menguntungkan.

martechInsight.en: Ad platforms individually overclaimed RM 114,230.42 against RM 71,022.92 in actual bank-verified cash (+60.8% overclaim across 392 orders) while Google Branded (0.80x Acq Net POAS) and PMax (0.77x Acq Net POAS) masked negative new-customer acquisition profit behind returning-buyer clicks and TikTok/Meta view-through hijacks. Combining first-party localStorage FPX shield tracking, 70%/30% HDYHAU triangulation, and ±20% HITL budget gates prevents double-counting without resetting ad learning phases.
martechInsight.bm: Platform iklan menuntut RM 114,230.42 secara berasingan berbanding RM 71,022.92 tunai sah bank (lebihan tuntutan +60.8% merentasi 392 pesanan), manakala Google Branded (Acq Net POAS 0.80x) dan PMax (0.77x) menyembunyikan kerugian pemerolehan pelanggan baharu di sebalik klik pembeli ulangan serta rampasan view-through TikTok/Meta. Gabungan penjejakan pelayar first-party kalis lencongan FPX, triangulasi HDYHAU 70%/30% dan kawalan bajet HITL ±20% menghalang kiraan berganda tanpa mereset Learning Phase iklan.

commercialLeak.en: Ad budgets misallocated by +60.8% platform revenue double-counting, FPX bank-redirect UTMs lost at checkout, and Google Branded/PMax cannibalizing returning buyers and TikTok/Meta discovery sales.
commercialLeak.bm: Bajet iklan tersalah agih akibat kiraan berganda tuntutan platform (+60.8%), kehilangan jejak UTM semasa lencongan bank FPX, serta kempen Google Branded/PMax yang memakan jualan pelanggan ulangan dan penemuan TikTok/Meta.

deterministicGate.en: Deterministic FPX/Card fee & COGS deduction, SHA-256 NEW/RETURNING customer lookup, 1.0-capped 3-layer click + 70%/30% HDYHAU triangulation, Branded cannibalization audit, and ±20% Learning-Phase cap with RM 0.00 variance verification.
deterministicGate.bm: Potongan caj gerbang FPX/Kad & COGS deterministik, semakan pelanggan BAHARU/ULANGAN melalui hash SHA-256, triangulasi 3 lapisan bernilai tepat 1.0 (termasuk nisbah 70%/30% HDYHAU), audit kanibalisasi Branded, dan had pelarasan ±20% dengan pengesahan varians RM 0.00.
